title: NormPic Manifest v0.1.0
description: Schema for the NormPic manifest contract, v0.1.0. The authoritative semantic contract lives in doc/architecture/manifest-contract.md; this schema is the mechanical-validation half of the two-layer contract architecture. Rules that cannot be expressed in JSON Schema (e.g. the semantic equivalence of absent and null, producer style preferences, restrictions on '..' segments at non-leading positions in collection_root) are documented in the contract doc and enforced separately by implementations.

iso8601_utc_z.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with mandatory 'Z' suffix. Fractional seconds optional. Offset variants like '+00:00' are NOT accepted.

hash_b2b120.description: Content-addressed identity. Algorithm prefix 'b2b120:' followed by a 24-character BLAKE2b-120 digest in Crockford Base32 uppercase canonical form. Crockford alphabet excludes I, L, O, U.

relative_path.description: Path relative to the collection root. No leading slash or Windows drive (no absolute paths). No trailing slash. No empty segments. No '.' or '..' segments anywhere. No backslashes. UTF-8, NFC normalized (NFC enforced by implementations, not the schema).

collection_root.description: Location of the collection root relative to the manifest file's directory. Default value '.' is emitted explicitly. Allows '..' segments at the start (zero or more), followed by zero or more non-special segments. The schema enforces no '.' segments, no aliasing constructs, and no leading URI schemes (e.g. 's3://', 'https://'). The additional restriction that '..' may not appear after the leading run is enforced by implementations. URI schemes are reserved for future versions.

gps.description: GPS coordinates. Latitude bounded [-90, 90], longitude bounded [-180, 180].

timestamp_source.description: Identifies how the timestamp was derived. May be null or absent for optional+nullable semantics.

original_filename.description: Filename as found in source, with no path component. Optional, non-nullable: if present must be a non-empty string with no path separators (no '/' or '\').

timestamp.description: Best-effort capture timestamp. Optional and nullable.

camera.description: Camera model from EXIF. Optional and nullable. If present as a string, must be non-empty.

tag.description: Flat tag strings. Reserved in v0.1.0; NormPic does not populate this field. Singular per the ecosystem schema convention despite being array-typed. Each tag must be non-empty.
